findings.title: Localizable format keys use %d for 64-bit Swift Int arguments (notif_discreet_body_fmt fed a user-controlled unclamped threshold, plus other %d keys)
findings.evidence: notif_discreet_body_fmt at NotificationService.swift:158 passes Int(saturating: threshold) from notify_at (no upper clamp); service_status_*_fmt, reset_confirm_message, credits_*_msgs_fmt, compare_vs_prev_*_fmt use %d (raised by Higia, Jano and Nemesis, remediation B19)
findings.fix: Sweep %d to %ld where the argument is Int in en/pt-BR/es; add a validate.sh ratchet for %d in strings files
findings.impact: A very large configured threshold prints a truncated number
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B19
